subject: Request: SOC 2 artifacts + MFA / access review evidence
messages:
From: Julie Ramos <julie.ramos@goodhealth.ai>
To: karthik.iyer@redwood.ai, security@redwood.ai
Cc: 
Date: Tue, 10 Feb 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: SOC 2 artifacts + some follow-ups on MFA/logging

Hi Karthik / Redwood security team,

Thanks for the quick onboarding call yesterday. As part of GoodHealth's vendor risk review we need to collect the following items in addition to your SOC 2 Type II report (audit period we have listed is 2025-01-01 — 2025-12-31):

- MFA enforcement logs for privileged & admin accounts covering 2025-01-01 -> 2026-01-31 (we need to see enforcement and failure counts).
- Evidence of periodic access reviews (audit trail or review report; we typically ask for the latest quarter).
- SSO configuration screenshots or export showing 2FA requirement for all org units.
- Proof of SIEM ingestion/retention (log retention policy + a small sample header from SIEM ingestion showing timestamps).
- If your SOC 2 report audit period differs from the timeframe above, please provide a bridge letter explaining coverage and any control changes.

We attached our SIG / RFI template (GoodHealth_SIG_RFI_20260209.pdf) with specific fields flagged. Can you confirm the earliest ETA for the evidence and your preferred secure transfer method? Pre-signed S3 links or secure portal uploads work for us.

Appreciate it — we have a risk review deadline of 2026-02-20.

Best,
Julie Ramos
Head of Vendor Security
GoodHealth.ai
From: karthik.iyer@redwood.ai <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Julie Ramos <julie.ramos@goodhealth.ai>
Cc: grace.oconnor@redwood.ai, neha.kapoor@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 10 Feb 2026 10:07:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: SOC 2 artifacts + some follow-ups on MFA/logging

Julie — thanks for the clear list and the SIG. We can get most of this to you, want to confirm a few scope points to avoid churn:

1) Audit period — our latest SOC 2 Type II covers 2024-12-01 -> 2025-11-30. We will provide the Type II report and a bridge letter that covers 2025-12-01 -> 2026-01-31 outlining any control changes. Will that be acceptable?

2) MFA logs — we can provide a redacted CSV export showing successful/failed MFA events for admin roles and service accounts from 2025-01-01 through 2026-01-31. For privacy we will redact user identifiers but include role tags and counts.

3) Access reviews — we have a quarterly access review report for 2025 Q4 and reviewer signoffs; we can provide the PDF (redacted names where necessary).

4) SIEM ingestion — we can provide policy text and a small sample ingestion header file (no raw logs).

We prefer to deliver artifacts via a pre-signed, time-limited S3 link (we'll encrypt the bundle and provide separate passphrase). If GoodHealth requires a different transfer channel let us know.

Grace (cc) will be the point for the artifact bundle; Neha will handle the SOC2/bridge letter. ETA: initial bundle by 2026-02-12 EOD PDT if that works.

Thanks — filing this as action item now.

— Karthik Iyer
Head of Sales (Security & Strategic Accounts)
Redwood Inference
From: Julie Ramos <julie.ramos@goodhealth.ai>
To: karthik.iyer@redwood.ai
Cc: security@goodhealth.ai
Date: Tue, 10 Feb 2026 11:05:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: SOC 2 artifacts + some follow-ups on MFA/logging

Thanks Karthik — that sounds reasonable. A couple clarifications:

- Bridge letter: yes, we need the letter to state the exact dates covered and confirm no material control changes impacted the covered controls (or list the changes).
- MFA logs: redacted identifiers are fine but we do need a permanent role mapping so we can verify admin/service accounts were included.
- For SIEM: a header/sample plus the retention policy is sufficient — we don't need full event payloads.

Pre-signed S3 link is fine. Please make the link expire within 7 days and note the passphrase process.

If you can hit 2026-02-12 EOD that would keep us on track for the 02-20 review.

Julie
From: grace.oconnor@redwood.ai <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>
To: Julie Ramos <julie.ramos@goodhealth.ai>
Cc: karthik.iyer@redwood.ai, neha.kapoor@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 12 Feb 2026 13:22:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: SOC 2 artifacts + some follow-ups on MFA/logging

Julie / GoodHealth team — attaching the initial evidence bundle per Karthik's timeline. Notes below.

Attachments included (redacted where indicated):
- mfa_enforcement_20250101-20260131.csv (redacted) — columns: role_tag, date, event_type (MFA_SUCCESS/MFA_FAILURE), failure_reason_count. We removed PII and replaced userids with stable role tags.
- access_review_2025Q4.pdf — auditor-signed quarterly access review for Dec 2025 (redacted reviewer names).
- siem_ingest_snapshot.txt — sample ingestion headers with timestamps and retention policy excerpt.
- soc2_bridge_letter_20260201.pdf — our bridge letter covering 2025-12-01 -> 2026-01-31; it also notes a minor identity provider migration (no change in MFA enforcement requirement).

Delivery: bundle uploaded to a pre-signed S3 link (shared in a separate secure channel) — link will expire in 7 days. We will provide passphrase via a separate email to the GoodHealth security mailbox.

If you need additional fields in the MFA export (for example IP addresses or exact userids) we need a DPA addendum; otherwise the role-tagged export is what we can share for vendor reviews.

Grace O'Connor
Director, Security Operations
Redwood Inference
From: Julie Ramos <julie.ramos@goodhealth.ai>
To: grace.oconnor@redwood.ai, karthik.iyer@redwood.ai
Cc: security@goodhealth.ai
Date: Thu, 12 Feb 2026 15:04:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: SOC 2 artifacts + some follow-ups on MFA/logging

Grace — received, thank you. The bundle looks to be exactly what we asked for. A couple of final asks before we close the ticket:

- Can the bridge letter explicitly state the migration timeline and confirm that MFA enforcement was not relaxed during or after the migration?
- For our internal audit we prefer a short note outlining the role-tag mapping (e.g., role_tag:AdminOps -> list of responsibilities) — that can be a one-page PDF.

If you can get the short role-tag mapping doc and an updated bridge letter by EOD 2026-02-13 we should be good to complete the vendor assessment. Otherwise we might follow up with a quick clarification call.

Thanks again — appreciate the turnaround.

Julie Ramos
Head of Vendor Security
GoodHealth.ai
